title: Alappuzha family vows to continue legal fight against former DGP Thachankary
description: The Vigilance court in Kottayam found Thachankary guilty and imposed a fine of ₹30.84 lakh, leading to his transfer to Poojappura Central Jail in Thiruvananthapuram. Complainant Bobby Kuruvila expressed satisfaction with the verdict but vowed to continue pursuing justice.
